rules.name: trust-header-append-without-delete
rules.description: a trust-decision header is APPENDED (Header.Add, or append() of a Header{Key: ...} struct onto a proto/tunnel header list) in a method that never Dels/Sets that key: on a proxy that copies inbound headers wholesale, the pinned value lands AFTER the client's copies, every hop that preserves order keeps the client's copy first, and downstream Header.Get readers (first-value semantics) obey the CLIENT. The duplicate-header smuggling shape. FP class: methods building a fresh outbound request from scratch (nothing inherited to delete) — triage by asking whether the target header container ever held client data.
